A '''Focusing Core''' was a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] component. [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] [[Exar Kun's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] incorporated two Focusing Cores, one for each blade, located just behind the [[Crystal Lens Assembly]].<ref name="EGWT" />
